title: Equipment catalog document
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/equipment.json. Loaded by presets.loadEquipmentPreset / getEquipmentItem. Storage: catalog document (items[]).

customSpriteGenre.description: Optional catalog genre for Custom Sprite when different from the mode genre (e.g. steampunk while editing a standard-mode item). Empty = mode genre. Controls the catalog list and wiki/runtime sprite path for customSprite.

customSprite.description: Optional genre equipment catalog id used for art when this combat item has no matching sprite under its own id. Designer: Select opens the equipment art catalog filtered by customSpriteGenre (or mode genre). Alpha thumb preview in wiki and form.

slot.description: Equipment slot (rightHand, leftHand, head, body, legs, feet, …).

weaponType.description: Weapon family for power curves (melee, distance, magic, shield, …).

defenseBonus.description: Weapon extradef / defense modifier. Applied to total defense only when a shield contributes defense > 0.

stackable.description: When true, identical itemId instances merge into one container slot with count (weight = unit × count). Max stack size is 100. Used for arrows/bolts, throwing weapons (spears/stars), and runes (category rune).

breakChance.description: Throwing weapons only: percent chance (0–100) to destroy one stack unit on each throw (hit or miss). 100 = always consume one. Cap weight uses unit × remaining count.

ammoType.description: Required for category ammo: which distance weapon may fire this stack. Bows consume arrow; crossbows consume bolt. Used for O(1) matching when scanning a quiver.

durationSec.description: Temporary item lifetime in seconds (data-only until tick/decay stage).

customSprite.description: Temporary art catalog stem when combat id has no matching sprite under assets/sprites/<genre>/equipment/.

spriteId.description: Alias of customSprite (equipment picker historically reads spriteId).
